summary: A three-story, tiered building with a complex footprint consisting of a large oval and a rectangular side protrusion. The structure is built primarily of wood with prominent horizontal stone brick banding separating the tiers. It features a flat roof filled with a dark red material, topped with a central glass skylight, and is surrounded by a low, spaced stone brick perimeter wall.

shape.overall_form: tiered oval with a rectangular side extension

materials.name: stonebrick
materials.role: horizontal banding, trim, and structural accents

materials.name: slab_stone
materials.role: perimeter wall and skylight roof capping

rebuild_hints: Begin by laying out the complex footprint: a large oval shape with a rectangular extension on one side.
Build upwards in three receding tiers, using wood blocks for the walls and placing vertical wood pillars at regular intervals.
Cap each tier with a continuous horizontal band of stone bricks before starting the next recessed level.
Fill the top flat roof area with netherrack (or a similar dark red block) and border it with stone bricks.
Construct a raised 5x5 central skylight using glass blocks/panes and stone slabs, placing a glowstone block in the center.
Surround the entire structure with a low perimeter wall made of spaced stone brick blocks or slabs.
uncertainties: The exact block dimensions and curvature of the oval footprint.
The specific dark red block used for the roof surface (highly likely netherrack, but could be red nether bricks or similar).
The interior layout, flooring, and access mechanisms between tiers are completely hidden.
